question: Which state government has extended the ₹1 lakh marriage incentive to couples where both spouses are differently-abled?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Telangana extends ₹1 lakh marriage incentive to couples where both are differently-abled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Telangana government** has **extended the ₹1 lakh marriage incentive** to couples where **both individuals are differently-abled**.

 
 
• 
 
Previously, the incentive was given **only if one partner** was differently-abled.

 
 
• 
 
The **cash benefit will be given in the name of the wife**.

 
 
• 
 
A **Government Order (GO)** has been issued for this change.

 
 
• 
 
The amount of the incentive was **raised from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 in March 2018** by the previous government.
